messages:
Neha (Product): Heads-up: Customer A expects a pilot for their regulated workload within Q3. We need a razor-minimal launch checklist that balances security needs and our dev timeline. Quick ideas?
Liam (Eng-Arch): Must-have: routing policy templates (affinity + fallback), slice API with quota enforcement, and model-variant fallback. Keep heavy infra (VPC/KMS) as optional.
Jordan (SRE): Ops must: per-tenant P95/P99, error dashboards, canary rollback automation, a simple capacity cutover playbook, and a failure-injection test.
Vivian (Solutions): Customer wants 1yr audit retention, capacity reservations for peak windows, and a named oncall for incident drills. If we can't provide KMS yet, a signed audit manifest could work for the pilot.
Mike (Eng Lead): Proposed minimal scope: 1) Routing templates + console + API, 2) Slice create/modify + quota checks, 3) Audit-log to S3 + signed manifest, 4) Canary + automatic fallback. Ship VPC/KMS as enterprise add-on (Q4).
Priya (Legal): We need a draft SLA clause for pilot credits and data-retention commitments. I can prepare a short pilot addendum template.
Sam (Customer A): Pilot is ok if reservations + audit manifest exist and we can run in us-east for 2 weeks. We'll want a simple rollback drill.
Neha (Product): Acceptance checklist (draft): - Routing templates in console + API - Slice lifecycle + quota enforcement - Per-tenant metrics (P50/P95/P99) - Canary rollout + auto-fallback - Audit ingestion to S3 + signed manifest - Reservation UI / reservation contract text - Runbook + failure-injection test - Pilot SLA addendum
Liam (Eng-Arch): I'll post an RFC tonight with a compact policy DSL example: ```policy { affinity: region("us-east-1"); primary_variant: "llama-q4f16"; fallback: ["gptq-small","cpu-fallback"]; max_tail_ms: 300 }```
Jordan (SRE): I'll draft the SRE checklist and load test plan tomorrow. Need env for simulated tenant load.
Vivian (Solutions): Sales can pitch reservations with simple vGPU-hour bands and an upgrade path to Private. I'll draft the quote fields.
rollout-bot: Created epic 'regulated-pilot-slice' targeted for Q3-beta.
Neha (Product): Actions: Liam -> RFC (EOD), Jordan -> SRE checklist (tomorrow), Mike -> MLP scope PR (Mon), Priya -> pilot addendum draft (Mon), Vivian -> reservation quote template (Mon). I'll update roadmap doc. Thanks!
